Payments that did not post (excluded)

Charged on TLPE (TRANSACTION SUCCESSFUL) but the SSS receipt showed Payment Posting Failed. All five happened between 16:28 and 16:41 PHT, just before the benchmark window, and are excluded from every number above. The next payment (Run 1, 16:42) posted normally, which points to a temporary SSS posting outage rather than a PRN or member-type problem. Please check these references.

Evidence — Run 4 (PRN OC250000001300, txn 261015084554KCZ2427)

One screenshot per step, captured by the benchmark. Dashed frames are payment gateway pages. Every run is also recorded on video in benchmarks/swb-sss-input-prn/videos/.

Method and notes

  • BLR Platform runtime = steps 1–5 and 8: PRN input, PRN lookup, Consent, hand-off to TLPE Customer Details, TLPE Next to Confirm Payment, and the return to the Payment Posted receipt.
  • Payment gateway (excluded) = steps 6–7: PAY → 3DS Simulator, and Approve + Submit → TRANSACTION SUCCESSFUL.
  • Fresh visitor each run: new browser session with no cookies or cache.
  • Headed browser required: in headless Chromium, TLPE shows "Sorry, something went wrong" after PAY and never reaches 3DS.
  • Only posted runs count: if the receipt says Payment Posting Failed, the PRN is logged as used and the run repeats with the next PRN.
  • Possible bug found: clicking Next on the Checkout Summary before the page finishes loading skips the Consent pop-up and goes straight to TLPE.
  • After the code enhancement: run the same benchmark on V1 with BENCH_LABEL=V1-enhanced BENCH_RUNS=4 and compare the BLR Platform runtime against this baseline.
